ruled_out_vectors.vector: Tick crossing at exact boundary — liquidity not properly added/removed
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Standard Uniswap V3 tick crossing logic. `sqrtPriceCurrentX96 == nextTickSqrtPriceX96` check at DynamicHelper.sol:411 is battle-tested.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Fixed height split rounds to zero on one side — free tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: mulDivRoundingUp for input (user pays more), calculateFixedSwapByRatioRoundingDown for output (user gets less). Zero-value guard at FixedHelper.sol:1656.
Known design (L-04). 100% input fee → amountRemainingLessFee=0 → amountIn=0. Output rejects 100%. No extraction.
Known (L-01). Defaults to widest price limit. AMM limitAmount provides separate slippage protection.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: uint256 truncation on cast to uint128 in AMMModule safe math
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Assembly implementations in _safeIncrementUint128/_safeDecrementUint128 correctly check overflow with shr(128, sum).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Division before multiplication truncates intermediate → pay less fee
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All fee/swap calculations use FullMath.mulDiv/mulDivRoundingUp with 512-bit intermediate products. No precision loss.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Assembly calldataload without masking → dirty high bits
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Assembly uses calldatacopy for structured data. Address values masked where needed. No unmasked arithmetic.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: ABI encoding attacks / returndata corruption / memory pointer corruption
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Solidity 0.8.24 strict mode. Memory-safe assembly. Standard ABI decoding with compiler protections.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust-loop extraction (100+ tiny swaps compound rounding)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Dust goes to pool (ptrPoolState.dust0/dust1), distributed to LPs on withdrawal. Output rounds DOWN, input rounds UP. Attacker loses fees each swap.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Forged hook caller — call hook directly without AMM
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _requireCallerIsAMM() on all hook entry points. AMMStandardHook.sol lines 110, 159, 253, 312, 940-942.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Transient-slot theft — stale slot from path A read by path B
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known CP-001. By-design: second call intentionally overwrites first. No exploitable stale state.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Permit mutation — replay signature with mutated unsigned fields
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: feeOnTop unsigned is known (rejected submission). limitAmount caps total exposure regardless of feeOnTop.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Storage-slot collision — deploy facet writing to another facet's slot
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool types are external contracts (regular calls, not delegatecall). State keyed by msg.sender. Diamond storage at 0x9A1D isolated.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Operator precedence bug in FixedHelper amount validation
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Solidity parses `amount0 | amount1 > type(uint128).max` as `(amount0 | amount1) > type(uint128).max`. Verified via Chisel: `uint256 | bool` causes compile error, proving grouped parsing. Guard works correctly.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: SingleProviderHelper roundtrip precision leak via two-step sqrt decomposition
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: calculateFixedInput rounds DOWN twice (user gets less output). calculateFixedOutput rounds UP twice (user pays more input). Roundtrip verified safe via Chisel.
Fallback to swapByOutput recalculates amountIn from scratch based on output, not from fee-deducted amount. Line 917 check ensures recalculated total <= original input.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Cross-boundary fee flow mismatch between pool types and AMMModule
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _validateProtocolFees computes expectedProtocolFee with same formula pool types use. Rounding differences favor protocol. No exploitable gap.

theft_theses.thesis: Exploit rounding at tick boundaries to get more output than paid for during dynamic pool swaps
Exploit fixed pool height split rounding to extract free tokens via dust accumulation
Exploit fee calculation precision differences between pool types and AMMModule to extract value
